beats.say: Guess what share of India's firecrackers come from just one town.
It's Sivakasi, in Tamil Nadu. Over a thousand licensed factories. About three lakh workers.
lines: Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu. About 3 lakh workers.

beats.say: Seven thousand crore rupees a year. And most of it sells around Diwali.
lines: Most of it sold around Diwali

beats.say: Now, here's the twist. This Diwali, crackers cost thirty to fifty percent more.
Why? Sulphur jumped from seventy-five rupees a kilo, to one hundred and forty.
lines: Up from ₹75. Raw materials up about 30%.

beats.say: So, the answer? About eighty-five to ninety percent. Nearly nine in ten. Did you guess right? Tell me in the comments.
lines: Nearly 9 in 10. Did you guess right? Tell us below.
